It appears that the applicant was found in possession of   Masala and Guthaka.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: However, having regard to the facts and  circumstances of the case, prima facie the applicability of Sectio  328 of the IPC appears to be doubtful.
opennyai_summary.22_December_2021__decision:
The applicant therefore has  made out a case for ad-interim protection.
Hence the following  order is passed :
 ORDER Kupram Kaluram Choudhary vs State Of Maharashtra on 22 December, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51843669/
1
(i) In the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R.No. 61 of 2021 registered with Chaturshringi Police ABA-3102-2021.DOC Station, Pune City for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273,
328 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26 (2) (i), 26 (2) (iv) and 30 (2) (a) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the applicant be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR & SB in the sum of Rs.
20,000/- with one or two surety/sureties in like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer of concerned police station as and when required.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iv) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 20th January, 2022.
(v) This order shall remain in force till the next date.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
2. This application is preferred for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.61 of 2021, registered with Chaturshringi Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 30(2)(a), 26(2)(i) and 26(2)(iv) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. By an order dated 22nd December, 2021, this Court was persuaded to grant interim pre-arrest bail.
In the intervening period, investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been 16-ABA3102-21.DOC lodged on 4th March, 2022.
It appears that pursuant to the orders passed by this Court, on 15 th January, 2022 the applicant was arrested and released on bail.
4. In the aforesaid view of the matter, the application for pre- arrest, having served its purpose,
stands disposed.
